verdict.rationale: AFK's own AI decomposes goals into a directed graph of steps and acts across connected tools (Mercury, Gusto, Carta, Stripe), so AI-driven steps with tool use exist inside its workflows. There is no evidence that users can insert their own AI agent or LLM steps or choose a model. missing for 10: user-configurable AI/LLM step insertion, model choice, documented per-step tool configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI agent or LLM steps inside a workflow, with model choice and tool use

citations.quote: Set a goal like "Get to $1m ARR" and AI decomposes it into tasks
Every task becomes a directed graph of steps.
Query and act across Mercury, Gusto, Carta, Stripe, and more from a single surface.
